description: This file is a test script for the Git version control system, specifically testing pathspec globs and related options such as noglob, literal paths, and glob patterns. It defines a series of test cases to verify the behavior of Git commands with different path specifications.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting a successful execution of the commands within the block.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified files and content.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the commit timestamp for test consistency.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the expected and actual output files.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the output is empty, indicating no matches or output.
